**Short answer:** The Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W stand is the best all-around pick. The ESR CryoBoost is the better value. I couldn't open WIRED's roundup, so I'm relying on Macworld's Satechi review and the ESR deal page.

**Best overall: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand (Qi2 25W), $129.99**
- It charges an iPhone at up to 25W (Qi2.2). The Apple Watch pad and the AirPods pad are each rated at 5W.
- The pad is adjustable, with a weighted hinge and a 160-degree viewing angle. Macworld says "none stand as tall or are as adjustable as this one."
- It folds for travel. A 45W adapter and US, UK and EU plugs are included.
- The drawback is weight. At 399g it is more than twice as heavy as the Kuxiu X40 or the ESR Foldable, which are lighter travel options.
- Buy it at [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V), [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w), [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW), [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html) or [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Satechi-3-in-1-Qi2-Wireless-Charging-Station-25W-Fast-Magnetic-Charger-Foldable-Stand-iPhone-Apple-Watch-AirPods-45W-USB-C-Adapter-Included-Space-Bla/19875453032).

**Best value: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25W), about $82 with a code**
- The list price is $99.99. The code PARTNER18 takes 18% off, which brings it to about $82. The deal page says the code expires 2026-12-31 and was tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-23. Check the final price at checkout.
- It has an active cooling fan and a 50W adapter included.
- Full 25W charging applies only to the iPhone 17 series, iPhone 16 Pro Max and iPhone 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W. Older iPhones get 15W.
- It comes with a 12-month warranty, or 24 months if you register. Returns are accepted within 30 days.
- The 15W version is $79.99 before the code.
- [Buy the ESR CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no extra cost to you.

**Which to choose**
- Pick the **Satechi** if the stand will sit on a desk or nightstand and you want the most adjustable viewing angle.
- Pick the **ESR** if you want 25W charging at a lower price and have a recent iPhone.
- For travel, Macworld points to lighter foldable options like the Kuxiu X40 ($79.99) and the ESR Foldable. I didn't read full reviews of either.
